item.title: Correction · 255 Berry: The map notes called the developer Signature Properties and said the building was built in 2004; the developer's own page says Signature Development Group and gives a 2001-2004 development range, so a dated correction was added. The 'Signature I' naming and the milestone's 'Channel Park Condominiums' name are not on any cited page and were removed. The notes now give the 99 units and the architect from the developer's project page, which is cited for the residential use.
